issue.title: Agents Main deck: a same-subject background re-delivery clamps scroll and steals the user's Reply selection back to Context
issue.description:
While a user reads a Reply card in the Agents tab Main deck, a background same-subject Main re-delivery can steal their selection. Root-caused by phase sase-1lh.2 (epic sase-1lh, note #1 and PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4) while fixing the CI-only readiness timeout in test_renamed_generic_agent_session_root_png_snapshot.

Mechanism: after the user moves to the Reply card, a post-landing Main re-delivery for the same subject re-renders the spread and clamps scroll_y to 0. The scroll watcher then derives "context" as the active card from the clamped position and overwrites the stored selection (`main_active=context`, `view_active=reply`). The user's Reply view jumps back to Context with no input.

Commit 2e94255b21 only hardened the visual test helper (`tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py` now re-drives Reply after a steal). App behavior is unchanged. `tests/ace/tui/test_main_deck_reply_steal_recovery.py` reproduces the steal through the real scroll watcher, but it asserts the buggy state as a precondition (`_main_active_card == "context"`), so it must be rewritten when this is fixed. The helper's re-drive should become unnecessary once the app is fixed.

Fix direction: a parked-reader guard. A same-subject re-delivery, or a scroll clamp it causes, must not move the stored Main selection or scroll while the user has parked on a card. Only explicit navigation should change it. Keep tui_perf rules in mind: the re-delivery path is hot.

task_type_fields.impact: A user reading Reply is yanked back to Context with no input whenever a re-delivery lands; it also caused 7 of 10 CI visual-test timeouts before the helper workaround.
task_type_fields.location: Agents tab Main deck scroll watcher / same-subject Main re-delivery path (src/sase/ace/tui); repro test tests/ace/tui/test_main_deck_reply_steal_recovery.py
task_type_fields.repro: .venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/test_main_deck_reply_steal_recovery.py reproduces the steal (it currently asserts the stolen state main_active=context while view_active=reply as a precondition).

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1lh.2 root-caused this app bug while fixing a visual readiness timeout and only hardened the test helper; the sase-1lh lander files it so the product behavior gets fixed.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on current tree: the targeted visual runner failed tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_deck_blocks.py::test_agents_deck_blocks_spread_deck_sticky_png_snapshot three times (initial run plus serial retries), timing out after the Main spread loaded while waiting for spread_active_card() == 'reply'. This node has no split action and reproduces the same Main spread Reply landing/selection symptom described here; no golden files changed.
